scope: Current default owned compatibility reads over previously validated real ProGraph/Pastey semantic snapshots. Source is not reindexed; existing stale notices remain honest. Each request uses the production isolated child executor and its existing admission/deadline/row/byte bounds.
methodology: Twenty serial samples per method/repository; time includes fresh worker creation, SQLite opening, authority resolution, read/serialization and IPC. Source database SHA256 checked unchanged. OS cache not evicted; no concurrent local provider/test/benchmark jobs. Empirical nearest-rank p95 of 20 observations is not a portable SLO or tail distribution. Normalize only durationMs for result-hash stability. Native worker/compiler RSS unavailable; controller RSS is not substituted. No persistent pool or runtime code changes.
